plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Office Wordle, live drawing rooms, daily Sudoku and Higher / Lower inside your IDE. Native Swing compatibility edition for JetBrains IDEs 2019.1–2019.3, with Java 8 support. Requires the office Arcade Machine server.
plugin.change-notes:
Added daily Sudoku with saved progress on the unified server, compact game buttons in the order Wordle, Drawing, Sudoku, Higher / Lower, and fewer repeated information messages.

Compact native drawing interface for IDEs 2019.1-2019.3. Icon-only pen, eraser, line, rectangle and ellipse tools; one color button opens RGB sliders and sixteen presets. Shape previews synchronize on release and support whole-gesture undo. Drawing rooms hide redundant text and exhausted hint controls during play.
